precedence: explicit user word or character limit

research_article.label: Research article
research_article.architecture: Use IMRaD only when it fits the study and target venue.

literature_review.label: Literature review
literature_review.architecture: Use a formal review-article structure. Do not force IMRAD for a narrative review; keep evidence matrices and retrieval audits outside the main manuscript unless the requested review type and venue require them.

chinese_literature_review.label: Chinese literature review
chinese_literature_review.architecture: 采用正式中文综述文章结构；以目标期刊规范为准。证据矩阵、检索记录和引用审计是独立附件，不作为正文固定章节。

systematic_review.label: Systematic review
systematic_review.architecture: Follow the applicable reporting standard and preserve search, screening, risk-of-bias, and exclusion traceability.

short_communication.label: Short communication
short_communication.architecture: Compress background before evidence and preserve all conditions needed to judge the result.

perspective_commentary.label: Perspective / commentary
perspective_commentary.architecture: Organize around a bounded thesis, not a miniature IMRaD article.

methods_protocol_resource.label: Methods / protocol / resource article
methods_protocol_resource.architecture: Prioritize reproducibility, prerequisites, validation, and reuse boundaries.

chinese_journal_article.label: Chinese journal article
chinese_journal_article.architecture: 按学科和期刊惯例调整，不为满足字数重复背景。

degree_thesis.label: Degree thesis
degree_thesis.default_total: institution-specific; budget by chapter before drafting
degree_thesis.architecture: Do not force IMRAD across the whole thesis; preserve institution rules and give every chapter a distinct research responsibility.
